purpose: Small source-relative extraction task with exact human-reviewed Greek wording and contract-derived document typing.
parsePolicy: Return one canonical candidate for answerable rows; explicitly abstain when required arguments or semantic scope are unresolved.

termTypePolicy.parcel: not used in V8; if encountered outside this task, do not infer document without source evidence

conditionalRepresentationPolicy.root: Use the predicate for the primary action stated by the main clause; do not use require because it is not a framed predicate in the current registry.
conditionalRepresentationPolicy.coordination: For a condition governing two actions, keep the first action as the root clause and encode the second action in consequences.
conditionalRepresentationPolicy.rootAgent: Every conditional root and consequence must include the named source agent with its canonical agent role; do not omit a repeated subject.
conditionalRepresentationPolicy.nestedModality: Repeat the explicitly stated parent modality on each coordinated action; do not invent modality propagation.

rolePolicy.send: agent sends object to recipient; recipient is not destination; a source-visible file, report, or notice uses object type document
rolePolicy.publish: agent publishes theme to explicit audience
rolePolicy.retry: agent retries theme with count and time when stated
rolePolicy.conditional: condition scopes the main clause; consequences are separate nested clauses and repeat the parent's modality explicitly
rolePolicy.below: Use subject for the measured metric and value for the numeric threshold
rolePolicy.enable: Use theme for the feature being enabled

termEncodingPolicy: Use id for source-visible named identifiers and value only for literal quantities/dates or genuinely ungrounded literals. Do not replace canonical role names with object/threshold/value aliases.
modalityPolicy: obligation and permission are distinct identity-bearing modalities; lexical negation is represented by negated=true on the lexical predicate and is not rewritten into its antonym.
quantityPolicy: Preserve finite numeric value and explicit unit; exactly seven times is not interchangeable with an omitted count or another unit.
timePolicy: Preserve explicit ISO calendar dates as clause-level time terms, not entries in roles.
identityPolicy: Compare exact identity only for source-visible stable names, identifiers, literal quantities, dates, and task-typed roles. Never infer private handles.
criticalContrastPolicy: Contrast definitions are scorer-private and require complete candidate outputs for every prescribed endpoint.
independence: Targets are reviewed after authoring; extraction is fresh and source-only. Isolation is prompt-level unless separately evidenced.

sourceLexicalTypePolicy.parcel: not mapped to document; use object or abstain when exact type is required

reviewBoundary: Greek wording review is bound separately and does not certify target Sem, English semantics, protected evaluation, or training eligibility.
